name: @pipeworx/mcp-ip-australia

tools.name: au_search_trade_marks
tools.description: Search Australian trade marks on the IP Australia register by word. Returns the match count first, then trade mark numbers (feed one to au_trade_mark for the full record).

tools.name: au_trade_mark
tools.description: Get the full public record of one Australian trade mark by trade mark number: words, kind, status, key dates, owner and address for service.

number.description: Australian trade mark number as returned by au_search_trade_marks, e.g. "69153".

tools.name: au_search_designs
tools.description: Search Australian registered designs on the IP Australia register by keyword. Returns the match count first, then design numbers (feed one to au_design for the full record).

tools.name: au_design
tools.description: Get the full public record of one Australian design by design number, including product names and statements of newness.

number.description: Australian design number as returned by au_search_designs, e.g. "201915000".

tools.name: au_patent
tools.description: Get the full public record of one Australian patent by application number, as published by IP Australia.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-ip-australia forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the ip-australia pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
